note: Contract shared by tools/texgen/bld_terrace_rich.py (paints) and tools/blender/bld_terrace_rich.py (model). env_bld_terrace_rich: the gentrified env_bld_terrace_normal -- same 100 x 20 footprint, same 10-house / 10 u rhythm, same door sides and shop houses, same 15 u eaves + 4 u rise; cream and pastel stucco, white pilasters and window surrounds, gold accents, balustrade over a stepped cornice, slate roof with dormers, wrought-iron balconies with flower boxes, polished brass doors. Facade faces Blender -Y (game +Z). One ambient light and no vertex colour in the game: every texture paints its own shading. UVs stay inside 0..1 (nothing tiles). Atlas rects are [x, y, w, h] from the image's top-left (v = 1 - y / h).

model.pivot_note: The normal terrace GLB spans x -50..50, y -11..11, z -10.5..10.5 (centred on its own bbox incl. canopies and chimney caps). The rich model is built with the facade plane at y = -10, ground at z = 0 and then shifted by pivot_shift so ground, facade plane and house positions coincide with the normal at the same placement.

bld_terrace_rich_facade.tiles: none: the whole row once (10 houses of 32 px / 10 u), V = full 15 u wall height incl. cornice

bld_terrace_rich_wall.tiles: none: mapped once per end wall (20 x 19 u), back wall and chimney shafts
bld_terrace_rich_wall.look: cream ashlar stucco: pale blocks in running bond with fine joints

bld_terrace_rich_roof.tiles: none: mapped once per roof slope (100 x ~11 u); dormer roofs sample a small patch
bld_terrace_rich_roof.look: slate: blue-grey tiles with two lighter decorative bands, shadow under each course

bld_terrace_rich_trim.tiles: none: 16 x 16 cells, every face maps into one cell (half-texel inset)

bld_terrace_rich_cutout.tiles: none: RGBA, alpha clip 0.5; double-sided material
